source_scope: User-supplied local-build bundle inspection reports, esptool flash logs and physical serial captures. Not execution.json and not a successful qualification certificate.

retention.originals: Original attachments retained by the user; raw logs and binaries are not copied into this repository.
retention.hashes: SHA-256 over exact uploaded bytes, including original line endings.
retention.privacy: Developer-machine paths, serial-port names and board MAC are omitted.

verification_scope.flash_writes_verified_by: esptool Hash of data verified records

observed_failure_sequence: 24-Voice cohort renders only 2 or 3 blocks at 4188-5265 us average.
Producer-work backlog exceeds the configured 11610 us window; two active-measurement I2S send queue overflows are also recorded.
The bounded failure path stops the actors and returns from app_main before the 4096-block cohort and musical replay complete.
root_cause_status: These aggregate logs establish an early render-time/producer-work failure but do not isolate a DSP stage or prove the underlying implementation cause.
limitations: Only 2-3 cohort blocks are observed; no steady-state polyphony boundary or representative cohort quantiles are established.
Global render averages mix different loads and Prepare durations and are not comparable on/off capacity measurements.
Raw and digital headroom PASS apply only to the rendered prefix. The fixed overloaded workload was not completed.
Peak extreme-value probes passed, but no full real-bank peak/headroom or listening acceptance follows.
Peak drain_frames=0 reflects early failure; the final delayed block is only drained on normal completion.
Replay events=0 and complete=0 mean the musical replay did not execute.
The on-peak reconnect segment lacks an independent boot identity and start record.
No WDT/panic marker or allocation/stale-reference fault is observed in these short runs; this is not long-run reliability evidence.
PSRAM returns to its pre-run free value. Internal free memory remains 720 bytes below before; ownership and cause of that difference are not established.
Backlog is software producer-work accounting; dma_queue_overflows records the I2S on_send_q_ovf callback. No exact analog gap length is inferred.
Subjective listening notes were not supplied.
The historical bb31908b / bb31908-dirty baseline and the user acceptance of dirty remain unchanged; they do not qualify this path.

additional_partial_capture.attribution: Separate partial segment after monitor reconnect; do not merge into the primary capture or count as another independently identified complete run.
